# CI map

One page for agents: what each workflow in `.github/workflows` does, so you need not read the YAML.
Scripts live in `.github/scripts` (shared logic in `scripts/lib`, GitHub adapters in `scripts/adapters`);
each has a `test-*.mjs` beside it, and `Tests` runs them all with `node --test .github/scripts/test-*.mjs`.
For the human-facing rules see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (CI, required checks, tree reuse).

| Workflow (file) | Triggers | What it does | Scripts and tests | ADR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Tests** (`test.yml`) | `push` to `main`; `pull_request` to `main` and `integration/**`; `workflow_call` (from `release.yml` and the release preflight); manual. Path-filtered on PRs: `changes` decides which heavy jobs run. | `reuse` (skip if this tree already passed), `changes`, then `version-bump` (script tests, VERSION unchanged, changelog fragment), `backend`, `frontend` (typecheck, lint, format, screen coverage, unit tests), `image` (build and smoke test), `qa` (Gherkin suite, release PR and manual only), `pages`, `windows` (Pester, no-Docker start). | `changed-paths`, `classify`, `tree-reuse`, `check-version`, `check-version-unchanged`, `check-changelog`, `check-screen-coverage`, `coverage-summary`; tests `test-changed-paths`, `test-critical-paths`, `test-tree-reuse`, `test-check-*`, `test-coverage-summary` | [0023](../Documentation/adr/0023-releases-are-fully-automated-after-the-trigger.md) (tree reuse, one full run per release) |
| **CodeQL** (`codeql.yml`) | `push` to `main`; `pull_request` to `main`; weekly cron Mon 06:23 UTC; manual | `reuse`, `changes`, `Analyze (<language>)` matrix (actions, javascript-typescript, python; untouched languages report success with scan steps skipped), `record` the validated tree. | `tree-reuse`, `changed-paths`; `test-tree-reuse`, `test-changed-paths` | none |
| **Container scan** (`trivy.yml`) | `push` to `main`; any `pull_request`; daily cron 06:23 UTC | Builds the combined image, Trivy scan, uploads SARIF, reconciles critical image findings into issues, records the tree. | `tree-reuse`, `critical-findings --trivy-sarif`, `adapters/trivy`; `test-tree-reuse`, `test-critical-findings`, `test-reconciler` | none |
| **Critical finding issues** (`critical-findings.yml`) | `workflow_run` after CodeQL completes; daily cron 06:53 UTC; manual | Reconciles CodeQL critical findings with one GitHub issue each (opens, updates, closes). | `critical-findings`, `adapters/codeql`, `lib/reconciler`; `test-critical-findings`, `test-reconciler` | none |
| **Secret scanning alert issues** (`secret-scanning-alerts.yml`) | daily cron 07:17 UTC; manual | Keeps one labelled issue per open Secret scanning alert (never copies the secret). Needs `SECRET_SCANNING_TOKEN`. | `secret-scanning-alerts`, `adapters/secret-scanning`; `test-secret-scanning-alerts` | [0016](../Documentation/adr/0016-secret-scanning-alerts-become-issues.md) |
| **Auto-merge** (`auto-merge.yml`) | `pull_request`: opened, reopened, ready_for_review, edited, synchronize | Checks out the base branch and enables squash auto-merge only for non-draft PRs into `integration/**` and safe Dependabot PRs into `main`. Leaves every other PR (including `release/*`) alone. Rules live in `lib/auto-merge-allowlist.mjs`. | `auto-merge`, `lib/auto-merge-allowlist`, `lib/dependabot-metadata`, `adapters/dependabot`, `classify`; `test-auto-merge-allowlist` | [0022](../Documentation/adr/0022-main-is-gated-by-the-owners-merge-click.md) |
| **CodeRabbit label** (`coderabbit-label.yml`) | `pull_request_target` to `main`: opened, reopened, ready_for_review, edited | Adds the `coderabbit-review` label to `integration/*` to `main` PRs so the selective reviewer runs. | none (inline) | [0022](../Documentation/adr/0022-main-is-gated-by-the-owners-merge-click.md) |
| **Integration review summary** (`integration-summary.yml`) | `pull_request_target` to `main`: opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review; `workflow_run` after Tests | Posts and updates one summary comment on an `integration/*` to `main` PR: critical areas touched, required-check status, unticked ticket criteria. Never runs PR code. | `integration-summary`, `classify`; `test-integration-summary`, `test-critical-paths` | [0022](../Documentation/adr/0022-main-is-gated-by-the-owners-merge-click.md) |
| **Prepare release candidate** (`release-candidate.yml`) | manual only (`version` input), from `main` | Collates changelog fragments, syncs VERSION, runs the full Tests preflight on `release/X.Y.Z`, opens the release PR, merges it when the machine conditions hold, then starts publishing. Failures open a `release-blocked` issue. | `release-candidate`, `release`, `release-blocked`, `check-version`, `sync-version`, `auto-merge release`, `lib/release-conditions`, `lib/release-candidate-files`; `test-release-candidate`, `test-release`, `test-release-blocked` | [0023](../Documentation/adr/0023-releases-are-fully-automated-after-the-trigger.md) (supersedes [0018](../Documentation/adr/0018-releases-are-published-by-merging-a-candidate.md)) |
| **Publish merged release candidate** (`publish-release.yml`) | `pull_request` closed (merged release PR); manual (`pull_request` input) to retry | Validates the merged release PR, creates or reuses the version tag, dispatches `release.yml` and waits, reports or opens a `release-blocked` issue. | `release` (`validate-candidate`, `release-notes`, `tag`, `dispatch-and-wait`), `release-blocked`; `test-release`, `test-release-blocked` | [0023](../Documentation/adr/0023-releases-are-fully-automated-after-the-trigger.md) |
| **Release** (`release.yml`) | manual only, dispatched by Publish (input: merged release PR number) | Re-runs Tests (tree reused), checks the tag matches VERSION and is the highest, pushes the Docker image, builds the ZIP and GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG, verifies what was published. | `release`, `check-version`, `tree-reuse`; `test-release`, `test-tree-reuse` | [0023](../Documentation/adr/0023-releases-are-fully-automated-after-the-trigger.md) (supersedes [0018](../Documentation/adr/0018-releases-are-published-by-merging-a-candidate.md)) |
| **Ruleset drift** (`ruleset-drift.yml`) | daily cron 05:41 UTC; manual | Runs `apply-rulesets.mjs --dry-run` and opens or updates an issue when live rulesets differ from `.github/rulesets`. | `apply-rulesets`, `lib/rulesets`; `test-rulesets` | [0022](../Documentation/adr/0022-main-is-gated-by-the-owners-merge-click.md) (supersedes [0019](../Documentation/adr/0019-changes-reach-main-through-reviewed-pull-requests.md)) |

`dependabot.yml` configures Dependabot updates; `pull_request_template.md` is the PR checklist.

## Rulesets

`.github/rulesets/main.json` and `integration.json` are the source of truth. Only the owner applies them:
`node .github/scripts/apply-rulesets.mjs` (dry run, shows committed vs live) then `--apply` after approval.
`Ruleset drift` flags divergence daily; `test-rulesets.mjs` fails if a required check name stops matching a job.

| Branch | Required checks | Other rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main` | `backend`, `frontend`, `image`, `qa`, `windows`, `version-bump`, `Analyze (actions)`, `Analyze (javascript-typescript)`, `Analyze (python)` | PR required, branch must be up to date (strict), review threads resolved, no deletion, no force push. No approval count and no CodeRabbit check is required ([ADR 0022](../Documentation/adr/0022-main-is-gated-by-the-owners-merge-click.md)). |
| `integration/**` | `backend`, `frontend`, `version-bump` | PR required, no force push, not strict. |

A job skipped by the path filter counts as passing, which is why `qa` (release PR only) can be required.
